stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In the window 2026-11-03T11:25:19Z to 11:30:19Z, increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[300s]) summed by service_name was 0 for every service exposing an ERROR series: ad 0, cart 0, checkout 0, flagd 0, frontend 0, frontend-proxy 0, load-generator 0, payment 0, recommendation 0.

Per operation and status, every checkout ERROR-status series in the window read 0: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0. The same query showed payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 and cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0.

The same ERROR-summed query over the prior hour (ending 11:30:19Z) returned nonzero totals only for ad 6.10, flagd 8.14 and recommendation 6.10, while checkout, payment, cart, frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator were 0 for that hour as well.

Sampled checkout spans are successful: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server spans with status_tags rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and checkout HTTP POST spans with http.status_code=200, no error_by_visible_tags set. Trace ids observed: ff7ef114d5bf2d32185ea7bddefd54b7, a4ab5fa3216a1f29559307c96bd56ca4, 25185cafe92396fbaae175c82f37fd78, 7556d4a412cc3901c1179c4aa063099f, a6fd7fa788e353dea12b3c8f72873645, c02220a63e5fa55af99f524e6b4c9b2e, 74727fafb016d952832725d25810e5cf.

Checkout client-call average latency per dependency in the window: oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 6.12 ms, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 1.39 ms, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 3.86 ms, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 1.87 ms, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 0.48 ms, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 3.81 ms, oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder 0.75 ms.

Checkout client-call p95 by dependency in the window: oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 9.63 ms, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 4.75 ms, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 8.5 ms, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 8.5 ms, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 4.75 ms, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 8.5 ms, oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder 4.75 ms.

Comparable baseline 2026-11-03T10:20:00Z to 10:25:00Z shows checkout client averages of the same magnitude: Charge 4.29 ms, Convert 2.07 ms, EmptyCart 3.61 ms, GetCart 0.83 ms, GetProduct 0.51 ms, GetQuote 4.10 ms, ShipOrder 0.28 ms, so window latencies are not elevated against a comparable baseline.
